While on Death Star (even if imprisoned), Leia may not be transferred and her gametext may not be canceled.” Deploy 4; [A New Hope] icon. The PC card data's errata note (errataDate 30 December 2024): “Deploy reduced from 6 to 4. Adds [A New Hope] icon.” '''What changed:''' Rewritten and reordered: “Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise.” now stands first and applies everywhere; the Force drain bonus now needs Leia present at a Death Star site; “moves using landspeed for free” was dropped; “game text” is printed “gametext”. Deploy changed from 6 to 4 and the card gained the [A New Hope] icon. The card gained the E1 mark.
